description: WHOIS Alerts, Tech Stack, DNS, TLS Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.001 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/website-intelligence.

datasetId.description: Optional. Pick a dataset (or paste its ID) to read the input from, for example the result of Google Maps Scraper. When this actor runs as an integration, the dataset of the triggering run is used automatically (payload.resource.defaultDatas

domains.description: Company websites to analyse, for example shopify.com, stripe.com or https://www.hubspot.com. Bare domains and full URLs are accepted; each site gets one combined row. If left empty, five example sites are used.

includeCompanyInfo.description: Add the page title, meta description, generator tag and the company's own social profile links (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub) found on the homepage.

includeLighthouse.description: Run a real Google Lighthouse audit (headless Chrome) per site and add performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores plus Core Web Vitals. Takes 20-60 seconds per site and needs at least 2 GB of memory, so it is off by default.

includeRedirects.description: Follow the http:// address of the domain and record the redirect chain and the final URL.

includeScreenshot.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the homepage (1366x768 viewport) with headless Chromium and add a download link to each row. Needs at least 2 GB of memory, so it is off by default.

includeSitemap.description: Read robots.txt and sitemap.xml and count the URLs listed (sitemap indexes are sampled and extrapolated). A light check, not a crawl.

includeTls.description: Add the TLS certificate issuer, validity dates and days left until expiry.

includeUnchanged.description: Only used with a Monitor ID. Off = unchanged domains are skipped (and not charged). On = every domain is output, with an empty changes[] when nothing changed.

includeWhois.description: Add registrar, creation and expiry dates, domain age, days to expiry, status, nameservers and DNSSEC from the official RDAP service. No personal registrant data is output.

lighthouseStrategy.description: Only used when Lighthouse is on: audit as a mobile phone (Lighthouse default throttling) or as a desktop.

maxConcurrency.description: How many websites are scanned in parallel. 8 is polite; lower it if sites or RDAP servers rate-limit you.

minConfidence.description: Only report technologies detected with at least this confidence (0-100). 50 hides weak single-signal guesses; use 100 for the strictest list.
